name: @red-cup-engineering/receiver-owned-tool-agent-service
description: A provider-neutral bounded tool loop in which the receiver owns every executable operation.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one bounded message sequence, one named provider transport, and an explicit map from offered operation names to receiver-owned handlers
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: ungranted operations, malformed arguments, missing handlers, excess tool rounds, provider-authored mutation authority, or implicit shell access

execute-bounded-tool-agent.protocol: OpenAI-compatible chat completion with function tools
execute-bounded-tool-agent.returns: completion plus witnessed tool invocations and provider usage
